name: Suzukiri Futaba
source:
She is the main character's immediate superior and is an intellectual beauty who fits the term “cool beauty” perfectly. She used to be a manager at a major company, but was invited by Rumika, whom she respects, to join “OTL”.

The main character is strictly disciplined by the earnest Futaba, but as they work together, they gradually become close friends. The protagonist, who has been assigned to work with Futaba on the development of an “automatic p*ssy rope”.

The protagonist notices the hidden masochistic nature of Futaba, who seems cool, intelligent, and perfect, and performs SM play to test out the prototype. Futaba, who was reluctant at first, is swept away by the naughty pleasure of being tied up.

Sexual experience: none
